Definition: a prolonged form of G1746; to invest (with a garment):--clothe in, wear.
BiblicalUsage: To clothe, to put a garment on someone. The rich man was clothed in purple and fine linen in Luke 16:19, and the soldiers clothed Jesus with purple and crowned Him with thorns in Mark 15:17.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe clothes tell a story — purple on a rich man who ignored Lazarus, purple mocked onto a King who was dying for him — and God sees past both to the heart.
